text:
Leash checks at handover stayed on our minds, and we welcome your comments. You said the transfer process for your companion animal felt rushed and that you were not given enough clarity about what would happen next. Thank you for raising that with Aurelia Skyways, because those details matter to us and to every traveler who trusts the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Our standard approach is to keep safety ahead of speed on every journey. At handover, the passenger coordinator should explain the required travel steps in plain language, confirm the animal's readiness, and make sure the traveler understands what the cabin team will do once the flight begins. If that did not feel steady or complete, then we missed the mark on service.

Please know that every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and the cabin team is expected to monitor animals carefully during flight and keep the travel plan consistent with the welfare review completed on the ground. When a traveler feels uncertain, the right response is a calmer handover, clearer wording, and a little more room for questions before departure. That is the standard we want our staff to follow.

We are using your feedback to reinforce that the desk team should slow the pace at the point of transfer, restate the care steps, and confirm that all equipment and documents are in order before the animal moves on. This is routine work for us, but it only works when we carry it out with patience and consistency. If a handover feels abrupt, it can create avoidable stress for both the traveler and the animal, and that is exactly what we work to prevent.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We appreciate the chance to tighten our process and keep future journeys smoother, clearer, and more reassuring for you and your companion.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
